name: Agent-DVR
description: Agent DVR (next gen version of iSpy) is a super advanced video surveillance platform Supports multiple camera types, sensor types, recordings and alerts Agent DVR is the only DVR solution that doesn’t need port forwarding. That means no fiddly router setup or network security compromise for remote access. UI works on all modern devices from phones to tablets and desktops.
